seoTitle: Douglas County School District Calendar 2028–29 | Key Dates
seoDescription: View the DCSD 2028–29 calendar, including the August 9 first day, May 24 last day, school breaks, Friday delayed starts, and the official PDF.

schemaDatasetDescription: Reviewed Douglas County School District dates for 2028–29, including conventional-calendar school breaks, no-school days, PLC delayed-start days, and district holidays.
heroSummary:
Douglas County School District students begin the 2028–29 school year on Wednesday, August 9, 2028. DCSD’s color and list-view calendars identify Thursday, May 24, 2029, as the last student day. The conventional calendar includes 173 student days. Fall Break is October 9–13, Thanksgiving Break is November 20–24, Winter Break runs December 25 through January 5, and Spring Break is March 19–23. Students begin the second semester on January 9 after a teacher work day.

DCSD also uses Friday delayed starts during the 2028–29 school year. District-operated elementary and middle schools begin 45 minutes later; see the full PLC schedule below.
calendarNotes: This page covers DCSD’s conventional academic calendar. Most DCSD schools follow the conventional calendar, but Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish separate calendars. PLC Fridays are regular attendance days with a 45-minute delayed start for DCSD-operated elementary and middle schools; high schools continue their existing Friday schedule, and buses run 45 minutes later. Check your school for exact times.

whatsNew.title: What's Different From 2027–28
content: The first student day moves from August 11 in 2027–28 to August 9 in 2028–29.
Fall Break shifts from October 11–15 in 2027–28 to October 9–13 in 2028–29.
Winter Break shifts from December 20–31 in 2027–28 to December 25–January 5 in 2028–29.
The last student day moves from May 25 in 2027–28 to May 24 in 2028–29.
Spring Break shifts from March 20–24 in 2027–28 to March 19–23 in 2028–29.

customSections.label: DCSD Friday Delayed Starts
customSections.content: During the 2028–29 school year, DCSD-operated elementary and middle schools continue to start 45 minutes later every Friday for Professional Learning Community time. High schools continue their existing Friday delayed-start schedules, and school buses also run 45 minutes later. Check your school for its exact bell time and before-school care arrangements. Charter schools may follow different schedules.

table.footnote: Dates were transcribed from DCSD’s official Calendar at a Glance. Check your school for its exact Friday bell schedule.

customSections.label: Calendar Exceptions
customSections.content: Most DCSD schools follow this conventional calendar. Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish their own calendars. Families at those schools should confirm dates directly with the school.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school in DCSD for 2028–29?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day of the DCSD conventional calendar is Wednesday, August 9, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school?
calendarFaqs.a: DCSD’s color and list-view calendars identify Thursday, May 24, 2029, as the last student day, followed by a teacher work day on May 25. Calendar at a Glance currently lists May 25 as both the last student day and a teacher work day.

calendarFaqs.q: When are fall, winter, and spring breaks?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break is October 9–13, 2028; Winter Break is December 25, 2028–January 5, 2029; and Spring Break is March 19–23, 2029.

calendarFaqs.q: What is a PLC delayed-start day?
calendarFaqs.a: Students still attend school on PLC Fridays, but DCSD-operated elementary and middle schools start 45 minutes later and buses run 45 minutes later. High schools continue their existing Friday delayed-start schedules; check your school for its exact bell time.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are on the calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: DCSD’s conventional calendar lists 173 student days for 2028–29.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every DCSD school follow this calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish separate calendars.

sourceReviewSummary: Verified against DCSD’s academic calendars page, color calendar, list-view calendar, Calendar at a Glance, and Professional Learning Communities guidance. The 2027–28 calendar was also reviewed for the year-over-year comparison.
sourceReviewDetails: DCSD’s color calendar and list-view calendar identify Thursday, May 24, 2029 as the last student day, followed by a teacher work day on May 25. Calendar at a Glance currently lists May 25 as both the last student day and a teacher work day. Because the color and list-view calendars agree, this page uses May 24 while noting the discrepancy.

We compared the major breaks and no-school dates across DCSD’s calendar landing page, color calendar, Calendar at a Glance, and list-view calendar. Where official sources use different wording, we note the discrepancy rather than silently choosing one label.

PLC delayed-start dates were checked against Calendar at a Glance. DCSD’s Professional Learning Communities guidance explains the 45-minute elementary and middle school delay and later bus schedules; families should confirm exact bell times with their school.
Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish separate calendars.
